ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) in the basal and central regions, contrasted against high-intensity pixels (white) on the distal margins. Estimated macro-ratio of 65:35 low-to-high intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized dark pigmentation mass extending from the fluke base to the median notch. High-intensity white regions are concentrated at the lateral extremities. A distinct, high-contrast circular dark blob is positioned in the upper-medial region of the right lobe within a contiguous white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 30-35 degrees and a vertical penetration depth of approximately 10% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated profile with variable peak-to-valley amplitudes; most prominent jagged peaks are located along the distal third of both lobes. A significant indentation is visible on the inner-half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from the center, transitioning to an upward curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity (white) pixels forming irregular circular patterns on the lateral distal tips of both lobes, consistent with epibiotic colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical dark linear disruption on the right lobe intersecting a circular pigment spot; several low-contrast, unaligned linear marks on the upper-medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent large dark circular focal spot on the right lobe; irregular indentation/trauma mark on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white pigmentation field on the upper right lobe containing a single, isolated dark circular mark.
